        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_NoAlcoholicBeverages" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_OtherOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrder" targetRef="Task_WaitToBill">

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrder" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">not anotherOrderToPrepareOrDeliver</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_WaitToBill" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_DebitAccount" targetRef="EndEvent_BillingComplete"/>

                           name="Does the waiter have another order to prepare or deliver?"
                           gatewayDirection="Diverging"
                           default="Flow_NoOtherOrder"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitToBill" name="Waiter waits to do the billing"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Proceed to billing" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitAccount" name="Waiter debits the guest's account"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BillingComplete" name="Billing complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" targetRef="Task_OrderSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_OrderSommelier" targetRef="Task_AssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_AssignWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholIncluded"
                       name="Alcoholic beverage included"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded"
                       targetRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">alcoholicBeverageIncluded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholNotIncluded"
                       name="No alcoholic beverage included"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded"
                       targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_OtherOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OtherOrder"
                       name="Another order to prepare or deliver"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrder"
                       targetRef="Task_WaitToBill">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">anotherOrderToPrepareOrDeliver</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoOtherOrder"
                       name="No other order"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrder"
                       targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_WaitToBill" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_DebitAccount" targetRef="EndEvent_BillingComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_EvanstonianRoomService"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/evanstonian-room-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RoomServiceCall" name="Room-service call"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RoomService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Hotel" name="The Evanstonian" processRef="Process_RoomService"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RoomServiceCall"
                      name="Room-service call"
                      sourceRef="Task_GuestCallsRoomService"
                      targetRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest calls room service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Guest">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Guest" name="Guest">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Guest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GuestCallsRoomService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_GuestCallComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Guest" name="Guest begins call"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuestCallsRoomService" name="Guest calls room service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_GuestCallComplete" name="Call placed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Guest" targetRef="Task_GuestCallsRoomService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_02" sourceRef="Task_GuestCallsRoomService" targetRef="EndEvent_GuestCallComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoomService" name="Room service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RoomService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Room-service manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RoomServiceCall</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitKitchenTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSommelier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholIncluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnToStation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OtherOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitToBill</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_BillingComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" name="Guest calls room service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RoomServiceCall" messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Room-service manager takes down the order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" name="Room-service manager submits the order ticket to the kitchen"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSommelier" name="Room-service manager gives the order to the sommelier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignWaiter" name="Room-service manager assigns the order to the waiter"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Begin preparations" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Kitchen prepares the food"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded"
                           name="Does the order include wine or another alcoholic beverage?"
                           gatewayDirection="Diverging"
                           default="Flow_AlcoholNotIncluded">
      <bpmn:documentation>Eighty percent of room-service orders include wine or another alcoholic beverage.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages" name="Sommelier fetches wine or prepares other alcoholic beverages"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" name="Sommelier's work complete" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" name="Prepare cart and nonalcoholic drinks" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Waiter readies the cart"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" name="Waiter prepares nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin" name="Cart and nonalcoholic drinks ready" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Food, beverages, and cart ready" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Waiter delivers the order to the guest's room"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Waiter returns to the room-service station"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OtherOrder"
                           name="Does the waiter have another order to prepare or deliver?"
                           gatewayDirection="Diverging"
                           default="Flow_NoOtherOrder"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitToBill" name="Waiter waits to do the billing"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Proceed to billing" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitAccount" name="Waiter debits the guest's account"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BillingComplete" name="Billing complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" targetRef="Task_OrderSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_OrderSommelier" targetRef="Task_AssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_AssignWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholIncluded" name="Alcoholic beverage included" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded" targetRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">alcoholicBeverageIncluded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholNotIncluded" name="No alcoholic beverage included" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_OtherOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OtherOrder" name="Another order to prepare or deliver" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrder" targetRef="Task_WaitToBill">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">anotherOrderToPrepareOrDeliver</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoOtherOrder" name="No other order" sourceRef="Gateway_OtherOrder" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_WaitToBill" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_DebitAccount" targetRef="EndEvent_BillingComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description assigns an action to a particular participant or distinguishes that action from related actions: label each corresponding BPMN element with the described action and responsible participant; do not substitute another actor or conflate it with a separate action
rules.situation: the description explicitly identifies the role or participant responsible for an activity

rules.instruction: When the description says the process begins when a participant performs an action: Model the process trigger with a start event, then model the described action as an activity after that event; do not use the start event alone to represent the action.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant performs an action that initiates the process.

rules.instruction: When the description gives an activity together with contextual or implementation details: label the corresponding BPMN element with its core action and object, omitting details that do not distinguish the activity.
rules.situation: the description gives an activity together with contextual or implementation details that do not distinguish it from other activities

rules.instruction: When the description states that one activity continues while another activity occurs before a later step: Model the concurrent activities as parallel branches, then synchronize them before a later step that depends on both being complete.
rules.situation: the description states that multiple activities proceed concurrently and that a later activity depends on all of them being complete.

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant performs an initiating action before another participant begins the process work.: Model the initiating action as an activity after a start event, rather than absorbing it into the start event.
rules.situation: the description states that an external participant performs an action that initiates the process before another participant begins process work.
